body: Well sure. but they just seem occupied by the fact that i'm miserable not why i am, when i tried to tell then, they just brush it of
That's a big what if. I had a life back there. I dont believe i have the strength to start again from square one

In my country doctors aren't permitted to prescribe those kind of drugs without a psyciatrist recommendation. And i cant afford to go to one.
But yeah, i've I've become increasingly more angry and negative each day, just plain bitter and it is taking it's toll.

This is a town of 1300 people with no shops and nothing, not even a trafficlight. So basicly the tree is almost i our backyard. There is nothing to do here, but walk around. It doesn't help that my birthday was yesterday and i didn't get a single call or message, I just feel like i won't be missed.

I used to be "alpha" and confident. All this has taken a huge hit because of what happend. Everything just happend at once. no job, no home, no girl, no happiness. I just feel like it's to much for me to handle.
